'''Rena''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He held the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]] and around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] was garrisoned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Garos IV]].<ref name="Mission to Zila" />
